root_cause: The datepicker does not update its selection when the user tabs away from the input field because there is no blur event listener that triggers validation and selection update. The existing blur listener (added in a previous attempt) only hides the picker without updating the selection, so the input field reverts to the previous valid date and the form data does not reflect the newly typed date.
repair_strategy: Add a blur event listener to the input field in the non-inline branch that calls the datepicker's update() method. This method reads the input field value, validates it, updates the selection if valid (or reverts if invalid), and hides the picker (autohide defaults to true in update). This ensures the calendar closes on Tab and the form data reflects the typed date for valid entries.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can reliably close the datepicker by tabbing out of the field, and the datepicker will update the selection with the typed date (if valid) or revert to the last valid date (if invalid), satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: The datepicker will update on blur even if the user intends to correct an invalid date; however the requirement specifies that Tab away should close the calendar and update the selection.
Inline pickers are unaffected because the listener is added only in the non-inline branch.
If other code depends on the blur event to keep the picker open for custom validation, that behavior will change; but the datepicker's own validation already runs on input change.
verification_requirements: After typing a valid date (e.g., 2024-05-21) and pressing Tab, the datepicker element must not be visible and the form data must reflect the typed date.
After typing an invalid date (e.g., 2024-07-15) and pressing Tab, the datepicker element must not be visible and the form data must reflect the last valid date (2024-05-10).
Clicking outside the picker should still hide it.
Inline pickers must remain visible when their host element receives blur.
Selecting a date via the mouse grid should still update the field and hide the picker if configured.
The blur listener should not cause duplicate hide calls or errors.
The regression guard 'Type a valid delivery date and Tab away' must hold with form-data reflecting the typed valid date.
